page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, printed page number 37 at top right. A large section number "7." with the start of the next word, set in large type, at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.l: [illegible, ~3 letters] in quo Tu me collocâsti, & ad quem
præsentì Regnorum ecclesiarum vocabar.
Vellem mihi Populus Meus, quanta mihi li-
berter negassem, eorum quæ in arbitrio meo posuisti.
Quæ in Ingrata Importunitate, & tur-
bulentis [?] iniqua Flagitantium, prodar illi de-
generi, & indignæ viro servituti, ut illos Conse-
n-[?]me in iis corroborem, quæ Conscientiâ meâ
perimadvertor & tuæ Gloriæ, & subditorum Meo-
rum recordando, tum, quod penitus Rationi & Iu-
stitiæ deluco, & alterari.
Fac ut solent patiar summas contumelias
& quibus maximè me premunt injurias, quàm ut vel
minimum patiatur adversus Conscientiam meam
admittam.
Salvæ manerent Populi mei (quod sanè pos-
sunt) Iuræ libertatis; dum id rectò & debito
more fiat animâ meâ nequaquam mancipatâ.
Quoniam Regis Christiani potentia Gratia tuâ
immutatis, ne me unquam patiaris Affliction-
ibus & Consiliis, quæ à Ratione, Iustitia, Religio-
ne aliena prorsus videtur, Ratione meam subjicere.
Ista Tibi usa, inserviam in veritate & integri-
tate cordis mei, licet his hominibus parum placeam.
Quanquam ab illis penitus expulsus fuero, de-
nerent Gratia Tua, quâ coram Te integrè possim conversari.
Dirige me in via veritatis & Iustitiæ: has enim
scitas, me ad pacem olim Tecum, & fœlicita-
tem perducturas, quanquam plurimas inter homi-
nes, [?]bitas, molestias perferam. Hoc à Te peto Ser-
vatoris mei Gratia.

page.notes: Printed page 37 of Eikon Basilike. The running head is in Greek letters, ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. The top and bottom lines are faded and show-through is heavy, so many words are doubtful and marked [?]. The first line is partly illegible. The section number 7. at the foot is set in large type and belongs to the start of the next section; only the word "De" is taken as the catchword.
